description: Imports past workouts from another app or file. Exercises are matched to existing ones by name; unmatched names become custom exercises, listed in the result. Up to 100 workouts per call; the same batch id on later calls makes one import, undone together. Workouts already imported from the same app are skipped.

app.description: Where these came from, e.g. "FitNotes", "JEFIT", "Notes app".

batch.description: Returned by the first call; pass it on later calls in the same import.

unit.description: Unit for every weight in this call. Defaults to the person's own unit.

done.description: True for a set performed. False for a planned set. Default true.

elevationM.description: Metres climbed in this set (a lap, split or whole run). Feet × 0.3048.

restSeconds.description: Planned rest after this set, in seconds.

rpe.description: Rate of perceived exertion as the person reported it, 1 to 10 in half steps.

weight.description: Total load moved (on a plate-loaded or Smith machine, the sled or bar plus the plates), added load for weighted bodyweight, or assistance for assisted. In `unit`.

externalId.description: The source's own id, if it has one.

name: trainrec_import_workouts
title: Import workouts from another app
